notes: Corrected כְלֵי קֹדֶשׁ הָאֱלֹהִים → the holy vessels of God: the innermost rectum carries an article and the ASV writes only one the with God bare, so under rule 29 the article takes that the and כְלֵי keeps the bare vessels. The article of מִקְדַּשׁ יְהוָה הָאֱלֹהִים stands on an appositive rather than the rectum and remains unrepresented.
